name: Brother Horn (minotaur)
notes: Brother Horn (story bible §8): the last Hornfolk warden, huge and heavy. Agent 0.9 m radius and 2.9 m tall: he needs wide, high passages, never fits a crawlspace and cannot climb, so the goblins' tunnels and the thief's rooftops are where he cannot follow. Unhurried walk 1.7 m/s and a heavy stalk of 1.2, but his charge runs at 7.5 m/s (faster than a player sprint, over a short distance; charge tuning is e13.13). Long legs: 0.6 m steps, but too heavy to jump more than 0.5 m, and he avoids drops over 3 m and slopes over 35°. Wades to 1.6 m (chest height on him); does not swim. Opens doors (he is the warden).
